notes: This adapter-backed slice maps the timestamped-interaction delivery boundary in §8.1.5 and the TAR equal-time cutoff in §8.14.4(d); the adjacent embedded TARA strict-less-than cutoff maps to §8.14.4(e). A receive-order interaction is sent as callback-path liveness evidence while asynchronous delivery is enabled; the mapped §8.1.5 behavior is that TSO callbacks remain gated until the constrained receiver requests time advance and are delivered before the matching grant with timestamp/order metadata. The §8.14.4(d) boundary sends two TSO interactions at time 5 and one at time 6: TAR(5) delivers both time-5 interactions before its grant, callback servicing after that grant delivers no additional time-5 event, and time 6 remains pending until TAR(6). The §8.14.4(e) embedded TARA case queues timestamp 5 before TARA(6) and checks the receive callback precedes the grant. The adapter supplies interaction class/parameter names, FOM, provider package, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. This does not claim asynchronous TSO callback dispatch, DDM, directed-interaction, remote interoperability, or conformance. The 2026-10-26 reviewed Lab backflow pin carries corrected source section labels; retired Umbra overrides are recorded in backflow_section_sync.

requirements.source_symbol: sendInteraction(InteractionClassHandle, ParameterHandleValueMap, VariableLengthData, LogicalTime); receiveInteraction(..., LogicalTime, OrderType, OrderType, ...)
requirements.statement: Asynchronous delivery permits the receive-order positive-control callback while the time-constrained receiver is Time Granted, but does not permit timestamped interaction delivery until the receiver is Time Advancing. After the receiver's Time Advance Request, the timestamped receive callback precedes the matching Time Advance Grant and preserves the sent timestamp and order metadata.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_asynchronous_delivery_tso_exclusion_catch2.cpp::Embedded asynchronous delivery does not bypass the TSO time gate

requirements.source_symbol: timeAdvanceRequest(LogicalTime); receiveInteraction(..., LogicalTime, OrderType, OrderType, ...); timeAdvanceGrant(LogicalTime)
requirements.statement: TAR(5) delivers timestamped interactions at time 5 before the matching grant; after that grant no additional event at or below 5 is delivered; timestamp 6 remains pending until TAR(6).
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_asynchronous_delivery_tso_equal_time_cutoff_catch2.cpp::Embedded asynchronous delivery observes the TAR equal-time TSO cutoff

requirements.source_symbol: timeAdvanceRequestAvailable(LogicalTime); receiveInteraction(..., LogicalTime, OrderType, OrderType, ...); timeAdvanceGrant(LogicalTime)
requirements.statement: A timestamp-5 interaction queued before TARA(6) is delivered before the matching time-advance grant, exercising the strict-less-than cutoff for the pre-grant message.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_tara_strict_timestamp_cutoff_catch2.cpp::Embedded TARA delivers a queued TSO strictly earlier than its supplied time before its grant
